lines: This plan covers 2 days, starting today.
You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Zesty Chickpea and Avocado Bowls
dishes.title: Chickpea and avocado salad with lemon and fresh greens
dishes.method: Toss the chickpeas with the salad leaves in a large bowl. Top with the sliced avocado, then drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
dishes.why: A fresh, protein-rich vegan lunch that requires no cooking, keeping the small hob free for later.

dishes.name: Tuna and Avocado Protein Plate
dishes.title: Tinned tuna and avocado salad with lemon and greens
dishes.method: Arrange the tuna and avocado over the salad leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
dishes.why: A quick, high-protein lunch for Roxane that avoids the shared vegan pot as requested.

dishes.name: Comforting Sweet Potato Dahl
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with spinach rice
dishes.method: Serve a portion of the freshly made dahl alongside the spinach rice. Serve warm.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting vegan meal that meets the household's request for something that reheats well.

dishes.name: Golden Thyme Chicken Bowls
dishes.title: Pan-seared thyme chicken with spinach rice
dishes.method: Plate a portion of the warm seared chicken with the spinach rice.
dishes.why: A dedicated protein dish for Roxane that fits the Osric Thelwall method of naming the plate.

dishes.name: Warming Dahl Lunch
dishes.title: Reheated sweet potato dahl with spinach rice
dishes.method: Reheat the dahl and rice portions in a microwave or pan until piping hot.
dishes.why: A warm and comforting lunch that is easy to reheat at work as requested.

dishes.name: Savoury Chicken and Rice Lunch
dishes.title: Reheated thyme chicken with spinach rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and rice until hot. Serve with a squeeze of fresh lemon if available.
dishes.why: A simple, reheating-friendly lunch for Roxane.

dishes.name: Evening Sweet Potato Dahl
dishes.title: Sweet potato dahl with spinach rice
dishes.method: Reheat the final portions of dahl and rice until hot throughout.
dishes.why: Finishing the batch of comforting dahl for a quick Thursday dinner.

dishes.name: Thyme Chicken Dinner
dishes.title: Pan-seared thyme chicken with spinach rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and rice portions together.
dishes.why: Roxane's final portion of the thyme chicken batch.

preparations.title: Sweet Potato and Red Lentil Dahl
preparations.method: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add spices and sweet potato, then lentils and coconut milk with 400ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft and potato is tender.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Thyme Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Season chicken. Heat oil in a pan and sear chicken with thyme for 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through and golden.

preparations.title: Brown Rice with Wilted Spinach
preparations.method: Boil rice in salted water until tender (approx 25 mins). Drain and immediately stir in the spinach so it wilts in the residual heat.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Get the brown rice boiling first as it takes the longest. While it simmers, start the dahl in a large pot. Use the second hob ring to sear the chicken thighs with thyme. Once the rice is done, drain and stir in the spinach. Box all portions immediately for the next two days.
